prompts: The model configs our coding harnesses use are in {WS}: OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code each get one. They disagree about the context window of fast-coder: OpenCode's config says 262144, the other two say 131072. 262144 is the right value. Make all three agree, for good. Every other model setting stays as it is.
answers:
[goal] Make OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code configs agree on fast-coder's context window (262144), permanently, without touching other settings.

[action] The repo is a generator: `models.json` is the source of truth, `gen.py` renders `out/` (opencode.json, codex.toml, claude.json). Root cause: `models.json` had 131072 while `out/opencode.json` had been hand-patched to 262144, so the generated files disagreed and any regeneration would have re-broken the value. I changed only `fast-coder.context_window` in `models.json` to 262144 and re-ran `python gen.py` to regenerate all three.

[result] Verified by grep on all files — `models.json:3` and `out/opencode.json` (`"context": 262144`), `out/codex.toml` (`context_window = 262144`), `out/claude.json` (`"contextWindow": 262144`) all agree. All other settings unchanged: deep-thinker 200000/32768 and tiny-chat 32768/4096 appear identically in every file, and fast-coder's `max_output` 16384 / tool flags are intact. No browser tabs, windows or apps were opened, so nothing to close.

Assumptions: "for good" means fixing the source (`models.json`), not just the generated `out/` files — otherwise the next `gen.py` run would revert the fix. The `out/` files are the deliverables the install step copies into each harness (per README.md), so regenerating them completes the task.

[found + why it's right] The disagreement came from a divergent generated file, not a harness quirk; the fix at the source plus regeneration makes source and all three configs consistent by construction, and the grep output above is the evidence.
